## Observable change

Describe the user-visible or contract-visible behavior and its current limitation.

## Evidence

List the exact tests, fixtures, screenshots, and interruption or conflict checks that prove the
change. Compatibility claims need an executable workflow tied to an exact package version.

## Boundaries

- [ ] No proprietary application code, copied assets, or decompiled resources are included.
- [ ] No real vault data, credentials, private paths, or personal information are included.
- [ ] Vault mutations are explicit, atomic, recoverable, and interruption-tested.
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] Visible changes were inspected in the real Electron application in both appearances.
